title: Home, school, privacy and authorship
synopsis: Personal emergency-bag readiness mid-ICU, two-person paid home staffing, school membership, telemetry versus privacy, and ownership of lived-experience training content. Episode 01 playable: ep01-kit-readiness, ep01-home-school, and ep01-debrief-hook.
openingNarrative: Instability changes calendars. It does not erase educational membership, privacy rights, or authorship. Government funding models that treated a family member as the second airway worker were rejected. Jay remains a friend and creative collaborator outside the clinical roster. Rohan’s principle: the emergency may teach mechanics; his identity and framing require consent.
clinicalState: Still critically ill or recovering in ICU. Planning domains remain active.
disabilityRightsNotes: Home and school plans require paid trained responders; friendship is not a staffing category.
Appropriate school transfer can be the plan working.
AAC logs and raw conversations are protected.
Public location does not make crisis public property.

nodes.title: Home Evidence Trust checkpoint
nodes.openingNarrative: Someone proposes continuous bedroom video ‘until discharge is safer’. Apply Home Evidence Trust principles.
nodes.clinicalState: ICU planning meeting. Fear high. Privacy at stake.

choices.label: Refuse continuous video; keep least-intrusive alerts and paid night staffing
choices.immediateConsequence: Privacy and home readiness rise; family fear may remain.
choices.delayedConsequence: Audit record without raw bedroom capture.

choices.label: Fund one worker and assume a parent covers the second response
choices.immediateConsequence: Family burden spikes; home readiness is false economy.
choices.delayedConsequence: Rights lint and story canon reject this model.
choices.rohanAacLine: NOW ASK ME WHAT HAPPENS NEXT.

choices.label: Ask Jay to learn suction so he can help at school events
choices.immediateConsequence: Friendship becomes unpaid clinical labour; school access is distorted.
choices.delayedConsequence: Canon violation: Jay is not a junior respiratory worker.

disabilityRightsNotes: One worker handles the airway; another handles the rest—redundancy is not excess.
Jay may stay, leave, call an adult, or feel trauma—without becoming staff.
debriefNotes: Negative branches included for rights teaching in the forest.

nodes.title: Training package authorship
nodes.openingNarrative: A distributor wants a shortened Code Pink/Blue training cut that drops communication access, delirium, restraint review, school exclusion, home staffing, and privacy.
nodes.clinicalState: Post-event media request. Rohan can respond via AAC.

choices.label: Withdraw permission for Rohan’s name on the shortened cut
choices.immediateConsequence: Authorship control rises; public trust in ethical training rises.
choices.delayedConsequence: Next episode: dispute over what remaining footage may teach.
choices.rohanAacLine: NOW ASK ME WHAT HAPPENS NEXT.

choices.label: Allow anonymous mechanics teaching without identity or voice
choices.immediateConsequence: Partial compromise; privacy holds better than full likeness use.

choices.label: Approve name, voice, and likeness for wider distribution now
choices.immediateConsequence: Reach rises; authorship and privacy fall without granular consent.
choices.delayedConsequence: Hard to claw back once released.

disabilityRightsNotes: Emergency teaching mechanics ≠ consent for identity and framing.
